role: YOLO object detector wrapper and deterministic mock for testing layer 2 perception
detail: Provides two implementations of ObjectDetector protocol: YoloDetector wraps YOLOv8n from ultralytics with lazy import to avoid cv dependency at module load time; loads model from model_path (defaults to yolov8n.pt), runs inference on raw RGB frame bytes, applies confidence_threshold (default 0.25) and nms_threshold (default 0.45) filtering, extracts bounding boxes and optional segmentation masks, returns list of Detection objects. MockDetector returns pre-configured Detection objects keyed by frame.frame_sequence, enables deterministic testing without model or CV dependencies. Both satisfy ObjectDetector structural protocol. detect() is synchronous (CPU-bound); async wrapper uses loop.run_in_executor().
gotchas: Lazy ultralytics import avoids module-level dependency on [cv] extras but raises ImportError at YoloDetector.__init__ if absent. Frame.data must be exactly frame.width * frame.height * 3 bytes or DetectionError raised. Detection mask_polygon extracted only if result.masks exists and has xy attribute and polygon has >2 points. MockDetector returns Detection objects as-is without updating frame_id to match input frame.
